headline: Forts Trade Hands by the Hour Along Contested Middle Belt
war_summary: With no decision yet rendered on the thirty-seventh day of the war, the map stands divided between settled districts and a burning central belt. Most provinces rest firmly under one banner, but the Deadlands remain split six bases to five, while neighboring Linn Mercy flashed through twenty-three ownership changes in a single day, its posts passing back and forth almost by the hour. Endless Shore counted sixteen similar convulsions, with Brackish Point the busiest crossing, and Farranac Coast, Marban Hollow, and Oarbreaker — where one work now lies in ruin — each logged fighting inside the last two hours. In the Fishermen's Row and Godcrofts sectors the Wardens hold near-complete ground, though Colonial flags were raised over individual points within the day. The casualty ledger is heaviest in the Deadlands, where the combined toll since the war began approaches fifty thousand. Fresh names appeared on every regional roll through the day, an unbroken tide of enlistment amid the churn.
